version.description:
Teak for Mac keeps your ideas and inspiration close. Capture notes, quotes, links, files, and audio, then search and organize your library in a native Mac window.

CAPTURE YOUR IDEAS
• Save a link, write a note, or keep a quote
• Upload images, videos, audio, and documents
• Record voice notes with microphone access you control
• Save the current page from the included Safari toolbar extension

MAKE YOUR LIBRARY YOURS
• Search your cards and combine type filters
• Keep favorites within reach
• Read content, summaries, notes, tags, and file details
• Edit card titles, notes, and tags
• Delete cards you no longer need

STAY CONNECTED
• Sync your library with Teak on the web, iPhone, and other integrations
• Choose your appearance and enable the optional menu bar item
• Manage your account and Safari extension in Settings

Teak for Mac requires an internet connection. API keys, import, export, billing, and connection management are available in the web app.

Your personal knowledge hub for collecting, remembering, and rediscovering ideas.
version.promotionalText: Capture notes, quotes, files, and audio on your Mac. Search, edit, and organize your library, with Safari saving included.
version.whatsNew: A refreshed native library, smarter search, keyboard shortcuts, and easier ways to capture and organize your ideas.
